review_text.en:
So, my girlfriend feels really bad. We agreed with the doctor that we will visit the clinic in the morning at 11:00. We arrived 10:50, at the moment its 11:45 and he is still not here. On the doors it says he should actually start working at 10:30. The pharmacy says he is coming - they said it 30min ago since we first asked. This is just a humiliation of its clients. If you have some visits to do before coming to the clinic and you are not sure when you will be done, then do not agree with people the time to meet at the clinic. My girlfriend is basically dying in pain here. Shame on you. Suggestion for you would be to open a clinic at 12:00 not 10:30. You are not a child, be more responsible!

To add up to my original review :

THE PHARMACY EMPLOYEES ARE VERY HELPFUL AND FRIENDLY - 5 STARS FOR THEM. However the doctor is making people feel humiliated. He was not late for 15minutes, he was late for 45minutes. We waited 55minutes. The doctor should be separated from the pharmacy and get separate reviews. Your rating is going down only because of him. He didn’t say anything useful today anyways. He said he was late because of the traffic. Sorry but he knew that roads are being fixed, they are being fixed for a while now. He did not even said sorry for being late. He made me the impression that all he cares is his 15euros.

en.text:
Dear Mr. Teasel,
It is most unfortunate and unfair to receive such a comment from yourself when we did our utmost to make your experience with us as pleasant and informative as possible.
Unfortunately we have no control on the doctor's arrival time as sometimes he is detained on medical consultations of an urgent nature. This is exactly what happened today and the doctor was 15 minutes late. We apologize on behalf of the doctor for this justified delay, however we did come to inform you that the doctor is running a few minutes late.
May I also add that when you came to buy the prescribed drugs ( Cough medicine and Paracetamol) for your dying girlfriend the pharmacist on duty took her time with you to be as informative and helpful as possible. you cannot deny this simple fact even though your attitude with her was rather gruff and dismissive.
We are most definitely not children and we take our responsibilities very seriously. All we ask for is some understanding from our esteemed clients that doctors may be detained on some urgent matter and so there may be some additional waiting time at the clinic.

review_text.en: I came in with my hoodie on. While waiting in the cue, nobody said a word to me, everything was fine. When I arrived at the till to request what I needed, I was immediately told to take my hoodie off. I took off my hoodie and asked why, because my face was fully visible. Then this redhead female employee of Maltese decent (description only so others can recognise her, not to offend) turns to me with a very angry face and says, "do you have a problem". Disgusting and disgraceful attitude... When I ask to make a formal complaint against the belligerent employee, I was told that this is not possible and that I should just tell the store manager what happened... I will stop by later to see if she has been reprimanded and if not, I will go further. Disgusting.

en.text:
Dear Mr. Larkin,
It is Pharmacy/Company Policy that hoodies are removed, purely as a security measure apart from the fact that one can never justify wearing such a piece of clothing in a temperature controlled indoor environment such as our establishment.
Wearing a hoodie and a mask makes an eventual identification from our security cameras, in case of any pilferage, very difficult so no, your face was not fully visible.
This 'Maltese Redhead' ( a very misogynistic comment ) an esteemed staff member who also happens to have a name has declared, corraborated by other staff in the pharmacy that you, gesticulating with your hans, told her flatly " Would you like to see this? " a very sarcastic and confrontational comment comment without indicating to which part of your body you were refering to, this is what provoked her unfortunate reaction. Perhaps you would like to include this comment in your narrative but you conveniently left it out.

We apologize if you were shouted at as this should never have happened but we would gladly take this matter further with you as one should never harass, in the very broad sense of the word, a person that is doing her duty.
Perhaps you should have understood and removed your hoodie, refrained from making unwanted comments and behaved

review_text.en: The doctor here is one of the rudest persons we’ve met in Malta (and there’s been quite a few) we asked for a covid test to travel to Spain, she charges 15 for the test + 15€ for “doctor fee”. We thought it was very expensive specially at this stage of Covid but didn’t say much. She gives me the results and there’s no QR code, nothing. We tell her that this is not valid anymore as it’s required have a qr in Spain. She tells us that we have to tell her what we need and I said to her that she’s a doctor doing this tests for people everyday and that she should know what it’s required. This lead to an argument in which she was getting very aggravated. She tells us that she’s not a travell agency. I said that I didn’t pay 60 euros for two tests which are going to get me nowhere. She takes us to the pharmacy as she’s not willing to do anything about this and one lady at the pharmacy and the boss where actually very understanding and gave us full refund. The doctor lady told us to “shut up” and “next time you deal with a professional, be one yourself” when she was the first one to not try to help or understand. Please if you actually need help of any kind do not go to that doctor. Unprofessional, uneducated and just wants the money. The pharmacy very helpful since moment 0.

en.text:
Dear Ms.Seisdedos.

We take note of your valuable comments regarding this unfortunate incident. We shall certainly discuss this internally and ensure that this does not happen again. We also take note of your kind  positive comments regarding our pharmacy staff and thank you for your appreciation.

May I also take the opportunity to clarify one important thing. The QR code is generated when you visit the Spanish Ministry of Health website regarding COVID requirements, the excerpt below from the website refers refers
"SpTH QR. If you do not have the EU Digital COVID Certificate or equivalent, you must complete the SpTH Health Control Form, manually entering the details of your vaccination, recovery or diagnostic test certificate."
So basically the Doctor was quite right in telling you that we cannot generate a QR code.
You cannot expect us here in Malta to know all the different COVID entry regulations country by country but perhaps you, as a Spanish National should know your country's entry regulations.
Lets be positive and take this as a learning Experience

El Medina Pharmacy

The older woman with the short hair and glasses was particularly unpleasant. Stock overpriced. Avoid and go to another pharmacy if you need medicine. Can only assume all these glowing 5 star reviews are from their friends and family! Have never been treated so appallingly just for browsing!!

en.text: Good afternoon, whilst we appreciate any form of criticism and take it constructivly we are not sure that we are the Pharmacy in question. We do not have any member of staff matching your description and at over a 112 square metres of floor space, we wouldn't describe our premises as small. As a side note we would aslo like to point out that all prices are fixed in all pharmacies around the island.

It is indeed a pity that we receive complaints such as yours as we take our custom very seriously and strive to resolve issues as quickly and professionally as possible to our customers satisfaction.

May we point out that although part of our premises are used as doctors clinics we do not actually go into matters between patient and doctor as the doctor operates independently from our pharmacy. We just provide the clinic and supply patients with the required medication. However, we do have highly trained professional and competent pharmacists and one can always seek further information at no extra charge, if such is needed.

We remain at your complete disposal to clarify any issues

The El Medina Team

review_text.en:
I went there with my girlfriend. She had an open cut on her leg that was on its third day and was infected. We knew, even if we are not doctors, that it was infected because it was red around the edges, she was feeling a lot of pain, and she couldn't walk properly. And then'the "pharmacist" (who is not a doctor—I don't know who gave her the space to work there, that's another thing) said, "You need to walk normal, it's nothing, you are not infected," when all the signs were saying that indeed she was infected.
We went there only to buy the necessary medicine for infections, while she insisted that my girlfriend was not infected and gave us some baby cream. She also gave other bad advice, such as that she doesn't need to clean the cut with oxygenated water and to not touch it at all. What a clown.

The next day, her leg got really bad because she didn't clean it properly. She listened to the
"pharmacist," didn't apply anti-infection cream, and now we bought everything but it's a bit late.
Her cut is really bad.
I hope this message gets to the people in power of this pharmacy. This is my first review ever; I never complain about anything, but this is ridiculously dangerous. Today was my girlfriend, tomorrow it will be someone else because of someone's ignorance and lack of education.

en.text:
Dear Mr. Doncevski,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback, and we sincerely hope that your girlfriend’s condition has improved since your visit.

At El Medina, we take all comments seriously, and we appreciate both positive and negative feedback as it helps us continue to improve our services. Following your review, we conducted an internal assessment to thoroughly understand the situation.

We would like to point out that all of our employees are fully trained, and our pharmacists have extensive experience of over 20 years in the profession.

Based on our pharmacist’s examination at the time, the injury presented as a very small and superficial cut with no visible signs of infection. It was also observed that your girlfriend was able to walk without difficulty when encouraged to do so.

When additional discomfort was expressed, our staff advised that a doctor was available next door should further medical evaluation be desired. This recommendation was declined.

Furthemore, The cream provided was an antiseptic product intended to protect the area and reduce the risk of infection; at no stage did our pharmacist advise against cleaning the wound.

We are genuinely disappointed to learn that you felt our service did not meet your expectations, as we strive to provide professional care and accurate information at all times. While we respect your perspective, we feel it is important to clarify the assessment made at the time of your visit.

Should you wish to discuss this matter further, please feel free to contact us directly. We value our customers and remain committed to maintaining the highest standard of service.

Kind regards,
The El Medina Team

The worst pharmacy in malta they make you to paty the doctor to get prescription and in t is mnot required for that medicine at all.

en.text:
Dear Mr. Mirkovic,

Kindly note that the medication that you required, is a Prescription Only medicine as can be verified if one visits the Malta Medicines Authority website.

Our esteemed Pharmacist on duty, Simone, was simply pointing this out to you and explaining before you rudely started shouting and stormed out of the pharmacy.

Simone, a very experienced community Pharmacist, has been working for us for many years and we hope that she shall continue to do so for many more years, excelling at her job in giving advice, free of charge, to whomever wants to listen.

Mr. Mirkovic, I invite you to come to our pharmacy so that we, again, can explain calmly about your medication and direct you to the Medicines authority website where you can verify what was said to you.

The El Medina Team Management
